description: This file contains an extension to the CanvasWindowController class, implementing window and panel creation, positioning, and management functions within a macOS application, specifically for the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: makeWindow
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSWindow or NSPanel based on the presentation type (window or panel) with specified styles and properties.

methods.name: presentAnchoredPanel
methods.description: Positions and presents the panel anchored to a specific point determined by the anchor provider, setting focus and bringing overlay to front.

methods.name: repositionPanel
methods.description: Calculates the panel’s position on screen based on saved frames, anchor points, and agent placement overrides, then moves the panel accordingly.

methods.name: defaultTopRightFrame
methods.description: Calculates the default top-right position and size for the panel based on screen size.

methods.name: setPanelFrame
methods.description: Sets the frame of the panel on a specified screen, constraining it within visible bounds and optionally persisting the frame.

methods.name: screen
methods.description: Determines the appropriate NSScreen for a given anchor rectangle.

methods.name: screenContainingMouseCursor
methods.description: Returns the screen currently containing the mouse cursor.

methods.name: isFrameMeaningfullyVisible
methods.description: Checks whether a given frame is significantly visible within a screen’s visible frame.

methods.name: constrainFrame
methods.description: Adjusts a frame to ensure it fits within specified visible bounds.
